SELECT real_estate_sales.id, ST_Y(real_estate_sales.geom) AS lat, ST_X(real_estate_sales.geom) AS lng, building_name, deal_type, property_type, deal_amount, deposit, monthly_rent, exclusive_area, floor_no, build_year, COALESCE(ps.transit_base, 0) AS transit_base, COALESCE(ps.education_base, 0) AS education_base, COALESCE(ps.commerce_base, 0) AS commerce_base, COALESCE(ps.convenience_base, 0) AS convenience_base FROM real_estate_sales LEFT JOIN property_score ps ON ps.property_id = real_estate_sales.id
ORDER BY real_estate_sales.id LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT MIN(id) AS id, building_name, ST_Y(ST_Centroid(ST_Collect(geom))) AS lat, ST_X(ST_Centroid(ST_Collect(geom))) AS lng, MODE() WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY property_type) AS property_type, COUNT(*) AS deal_count, MIN(exclusive_area) AS min_area, MAX(exclusive_area) AS max_area, MAX(build_year) AS build_year FROM real_estate_sales WHERE building_name ILIKE ('%' || #{q} || '%') GROUP BY building_name, lawd_cd ORDER BY deal_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT h.deal_ym, h.avg_amount, h.deal_count FROM building_price_history h JOIN real_estate_sales r ON r.building_name = h.building_name AND r.lawd_cd = h.lawd_cd AND r.deal_type = h.deal_type WHERE r.id = #{propertyId} ORDER BY h.deal_ym
